trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to the Link Chest by SEO Buddy
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to the Link Chest by SEO Buddy
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports lifetime access was revoked and an upgrade was demanded, and another says full access requires a monthly plan. This directly conflicts with lifetime access, despite one reviewer initially gaining limited access.

exhibits.quote: Access revoked???. I bought a lifetime access on my email and now I don't have access it asks for licence upgrade!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime access was revoked and an upgrade is demanded, contradicting lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: you will see you dont have 100% full access of the softwares features unless you get on their monthly plan.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports full access requires a monthly plan, undermining lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: After purchasing the life time deal, I did gain access to link chest but I noticed that our subscription was highly limited.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms that purchasing the lifetime deal gave access to Link Chest.

trials.claim: The Link Chest is a collection of high-quality, easy-to-win backlink opportunities
trials.claimQuote: The Link Chest is a collection of high-quality, easy-to-win backlink opportunities
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the links were low-quality, spammy and useless, and that 160 submissions produced no backlinks. This directly conflicts with high-quality, easy-to-win opportunities.

exhibits.quote: Once I got to the list, it was just a bunch of useless links, either profiles that will never be indexed, so they're useless for SEO, or low-quality, spammy sites that will never be indexed.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports links are useless, unindexed and low-quality spammy sites, contradicting high-quality.

exhibits.quote: I submitted about 160 links last year, and not a single one has shown up as a backlink.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports zero backlinks from 160 submissions, contradicting easy-to-win opportunities.

exhibits.quote: The site lists hundreds of high profile websites where you can get backlinks.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms Link Chest is a collection of high-profile backlink opportunities.

exhibits.quote: Linkchest is a good software, it has a directory of sites where one can easily get a backlink.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms Link Chest provides easy-to-get backlinks in a directory.

trials.claim: Saves yourself days of work and focus on action
trials.claimQuote: Save yourself days of work (and focus on action)
trials.reasoning: Buyers report spending hours with no functioning backlink and finding the product not easy and blocked. This conflicts with saving days of work, outweighing one weak comment that it saves some time.

exhibits.quote: Despite spending hours working through the provided list of backlink opportunities, I was unable to achieve a single functioning backlink.
exhibits.argument: Buyer spent hours with zero results, contradicting saving days of work.

exhibits.quote: I bought this product as it was supposed to be easy and it is not, All emails are seen as spam, even the logins are being blocked by Google,
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports product is not easy and is blocked, contradicting focus on action and saved work.

exhibits.quote: It is nothing extraodinary, you can hunt for the sites yourself, but the software does save you time.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the software saves time versus finding sites yourself.
